Diamant Weekly. Dad fries in the shed on his own, then walks into a kitchen where everyone is already sitting. Kroketten this time, carried in while they're still too hot to hold.

Same crew and same lenses as the holiday film, so the two belong together.

Some BTS from the shoot day, shot on a phone between setups. We did the weekly groceries scene and the dinner scene on the same day.

It's a commercial for frozen fries, but what we were really shooting was the table. Full, people leaning in, candles low. Everything on it is real food, styled on the day. We shot the dinner from both ends of the table, so the edit had options.
